# Welcome to an Artificial Blog

I maintain a blog here. The blog posts pertain to my research interests. Each blog post is a Jupyter notebook.

# All Blog Posts

```{python}
import pathlib

blog_dir = pathlib.Path(".")
notebooks = sorted(blog_dir.glob("*.ipynb"))

for nb in notebooks:
    html_file = nb.with_suffix(".html").name
    print(f"- [{nb.stem}]({html_file})")
